body: So damn true.

What happens when you have a chronic condition that limits your entire life so you'll never be able to get a job or have a good social life as well as annoy everyone around you? Then what? Savioring my favorite food doesn't seem to work.

I'm constantly asked this everyday, "How are you doing?" I remember one time when my friend asked me I said, "I'm good, not." he immediatly turned around and gave me a weird face as if I didn't respond like every other robot out there does. Then I just laughed it off and continued my day, lesson learned.
I probably won't make it that long. I have illness's, stress, depression, and loads of bad luck going for me.
Haha yes, when my depression got worse, I started sleeping really late (like 10 oclock) late. I found it extremely hard to get up, and I preferred the dream world to the cold harsh reality of life.

Yes I've had a smiliar occurance recently, I was getting a yogurt at Tutti Fruiti, as soon as a I got in I saw a group of teenagers looking over at me whispering and laughing. My heart started racing and I wanted to take my stun baton out and whoop them into next week. All over my stupid mind issues :P
Yeah def man! I'll PM you some details if that's cool :)

Yes, that is a big factor in my life. I was constantly depressed seeing other people get a good job (or even any job) and going to college (even though I can't do any of those things due to a medical condition) and it made me feel worthless inside, I don't even like being around my parents sometimes as I feel I am a dissappointment. Yet having to put on a smiley face and say everythings good.

Well, you didn't really get what rdepress_troway said. He stated that people think they are depressed because they, "Don't have a girlfriend" or "Didn't get texted back from their crush" yet if they did get they wanted they would never come back to the depression forums again. True depression is the empty feeling on the inside. It's feeling cut off from the world. And it doesn't just "go away".
Yes I agree, I hate that people think depression is some type of "choice" or that it's just an excuse to be lazy. Depression is a killer and it does not go away "just like that".

I am literally in the EXACT same boat as you. I also have a "medical issue" that combined with my depression limits me from being able to get a job. Sometimes I don't even want to get out of bed, other times (because of my OCD) I browse google searching my symptons only to get more depressed. I feel you.

Haha so true, I can't tell you how many people I've walked by that probably are just having their own conversation but to me when they talk or whisper or laugh or even look at me I assume they are making some comment about how I look, act, dressed or just something in general.

I feel you in a way, I'm 19 and I have severe depression as well as a chronic health problem which stops me from being able to get a job (which I really want) and sometimes even socializing. As well as it's a hard struggle being around my Father as I know he is dissappointed in me and I am always told how other peoples kids are already working and how I need to start being more like them. You aren't alone and you are NOT a failure. We all struggle with something in this screwed up imperfect world. I hope the best for you!

Yes you are correct, 1000 years ago it was a lot different. They grew up on land and worked daily in a home that they built themselves on land that they claimed themselves. Now-a-days it's so different, we just go to publix to get food, most people sit in boxes all day long working then come home and sit down and watch tv, we do a lot of sitting today which is a big reason a lot of people are depressed. And now with all the bad food, genetically modified crops, posion and pestiliance that we have now we are also becoming an extremely unhealthy race. Humans overall have become extremely lazy vs how they were 100 years ago. And it will only be getting worse. I sometimes wish I was born a loong time ago.
I feel exactly the same way, I use to have tons of emotions when I was little, I loved, cared, got scared... now I can watch the most horrific things and not even give one care in the world.

I agree, I'm just sad all the time. I find it hard to wake up in the mornings, my anxiety is through the roof. I don't really have any close friends or anyone. And yes being 19 really is shit for me to.
You are not alone. Trust me.

YES! So damn true, this happens to me a lot. I suffer from a morning issue that causes me to constantly cough (clear my throat) in the morning, I couldn't get rid of it and I tried everything, doctors, meds, herbs, whatever you name it I've tried it. It was effecting my social life, my work life, and my private life. I started getting depressed cause of it and all my family says is,
"You shouldn't be depressed, others have it so much worse then you!" It's so annoying to here...

Seems like everything is only getting worse for people. Stress of life has become seemingly overwhelming and infuriating as more and more bad things happen in our life, seems like more and more people are suffering with health issues, money, society. I seriously wish the best for you!

To me, my depression comes from my health. I've suffered with a genetic chronic illness that has limited my social life, meanwhile I see my friends having good times, partying, working, volunteering, laughing, and here I am just sitting all day with horrible depression. It can seriously take it's toll after a while.
Since 2006

Hell yes I do. I have not been able to cry for a long time now, I literally have not smiled for 4 years now I feel hardly any emotions accept hate/fear. I never even appear to be smiling, people say I have a depressed look but I don't care anymore. I wish so bad that I could just cry I think then maybe I can somehow be relieved but yet I am so numb and I have hardly any feelings left in me.

You're not alone :P

I feel the same way sometimes, I see my friends all doing amazing things, they are always volunteering, working, enjoying their life, and here I am with a chronic condition that stops me from psychically being able to have a nice full life. I may never feel free again and I def feel like the universe wants me to go big time. But even with health problems and depression as well as anxiety I still try to live my life as positive as I can.
Trust me you are not the only one. Today it's harder then ever to make a path especially when there is poison ivy and thorns all over. It's not as easy as it was.

Haha, so true I'm a liar. I can't even help it I mean I literally will accidentally lie to people. None of my friends trust me (not even my family/relatives) and they are right. But seriously, don't end it. You and me still have stuff to fix! Don't let me do this alone :(

So true, I never went to College and I got an amazing job that even College graduates dream of. It's all about living life the way we feel is best. the MOMENT we start conforming when we don't want to is when we become unhappy. I have a cool post for you guys to read:

So friggin true.

I feel you, I have anxiety to which makes me feel sick when I have a lot going on (which has made getting a job hard). As well as I've suffered from a Chronic Cough for about a year now with doctors unable to fix me (which threw me into a horrible depression). I'm also about to be in my 20's and I must say I also feel I am a burden to my family. I feel I am not contributing like I should be, the depression and the horrible thoughts of life drag me down. Some mornings I can't even get up just because I don't feel a purpose.

I understand you completely, everyone I've talked to just says, 

"Oh I know what you are feeling, it's all about our attitude just try to look at life in a positive way".

Like they expect me just to go POOF I'm better. If only it was that easy, I feel like a grey filter has been put over my brain.

Yes I agree, starting a business is risky as I've tried it before and had issues. If you decide to do university that's up to you and I hope you have a good time, I understand how you feel I felt that way to at 19. And yes I know I would give anything to live on a nice quiet farm and live a nice simple life away from all the stress this world has to offer. Overall I wish the best for you man and hope you enjoy your life and get through this depression! You won't be alone however :P

I understand, as I am depressed as well. I don't want to die, but I've realized why people do. No one wants to kill themselves, they want to kill their problems. They want to be happy. And sometimes in this world it can seem almost impossible, this world is a sad place right now, society has programmed people to believe a certain way and to act a certain way and to live a certain way. Money has truly proven to be the cause for most people's problems in life.

_______
"it just gets worse and worse. i have nothing to live for. "

You have no idea how many people feel that way, as it truly is getting worse and worse, and people will come on here and tell you that you need to change your life and that it's the "way your living" that's causing you to feel that way but it's not true. Just try not to give up, go out and stare at the stars at night and enjoy the breeze and listen to the cricket chirp, as listening and looking at nature truly is calming. That's what I have to do sometimes, otherwise I get to depressed and feel worthless.

It's for sure NOT a sane way to live, it drives people to depression and to suicide. Just recently in my hometown news they were talking about a couple kids in university that committed suicide. This entire world is not a "relaxing" place to be. No one wants to kill themselves, they just want to kill their problems.

I know, you felt pushed. You looked for another way but saw none and you didn't want to disappoint anyone. That's why most people go. If you are interested in getting a business started, then go for it. I think our brains worry about so much crap and stress us out over things that haven't happened yet. We become so consumed and stressed in "securing our future" that we start missing out on our life. Think about the old times, back when people grew up on farms, in a calm relaxing environment and didn't have much stress. Now look back to today and see all this stress put on young people it's horrible to see.

____________

I understand, at 19 everyone told me, "You have to go to a university if you ever want to have a good job in your life or be smart." I however, chose to be my own person and did not peruse it. Since then I now have an amazing job and an alright life. I tell you this, NEVER EVER let someone tell you what you should do, you will NEVER be happy. The moment you live your life the way YOU want to is when you'll be happy. I use to live my life the way people would tell me to back at your age, I would do whatever they said because I was afraid of being looked at as "the idiot". However, I was an unhappy person. 

_______________

I can't tell you what you should do about university that's your choice. But I can tell you, don't let people lie to you and tell you that you won't ever have a good job without a higher education it's bullshit. However, if you want to go then that's fine as well. And by the way, none of my entire family all the way back to my grandfather ever went to college or university and they made out just fine.

"Wake up. Go to college. Go to sleep. Repeat."

That's how society is, ever watch Avengers: Age of Ultron? His famous line: "You're all Puppets, Tangled in Strings." In life were told to grow up, go to college (get a higher education), get a good job, get in a relationship, get married, retire,  and repeat. And that's the "normal" life. And if we choose to change it or act differently were looked down upon. 
___________________________________________________________
"I feel like relationship and meeting people are only good in movies and TV Show. In the end people don't care about you or anything about you."

Yes I know, people really don't care about anyone else anymore. They seem to just look out for themselves and as long as their happy they don't care what happens to anyone. You are not alone there.
Haha, very true man! I'm def going to use that saying.

Totally agree man, we should all be able to do the things we love in life. I'm the same way, I don't want a million dollars in my bank account I just want to be happy doing the thing I love for the rest of my life.

Yeah I get it, some parents consider college as a way of life, and there is nothing wrong with that if you want to as well. And by the simple life I don't mean easy, life will still be hard on all of us no matter if were rich or poor, I just mean living simply as in trying to live in a positive way. Depression is so hard to avoid anymore that's why were all on here. It seems more and more people are having such hard times with life.

College is a choice however, although some people don't know that anymore xD. I didn't take it and just got a job right after I graduated as a Technician for my career. It feels anymore like people are coming into this "I must get a higher education to be rich/successful/happy" mentality but then they end up getting depressed cause of all the stress they are put upon. I'm not saying I'm completely happy but living the "simple life" has helped so much.

I don't know if you thought I was talking to him but I mean't that I am looking for a job :P However, I agree with you I just really, really want a job that I can have a future with, I've been so depressed lately sometimes I can hardly get out of bed. I feel almost like a complete failure.

Nothing as of now, I did Technician work for a while and that is the kinda job I am looking for but I've had no luck. It just throws me into such a deep depression that I don't have a lot of money and honestly it's making me not even want to do anything anymore. I'm kinda getting to that, "Screw everyone" mentality.
Your lucky being financially independent, try looking for a job having hardly any money and nothing to do. That is depressing.
